Morocco Issues Orange Alert for Heat Wave Reaching 47°C Until Tuesday
Morocco is set to experience another spell of extreme summer heat this week, with meteorologists warning that temperatures will climb well above seasonal averages in several provinces.
Agadir – Morocco’s General Directorate of Meteorology (DGM) has issued an orange-level weather alert, warning that a new heat wave will affect several provinces across the country from Sunday through Tuesday, with temperatures expected to reach as high as 47°C.
According to the DGM, the most intense heat is forecast in the provinces of Oued Ed-Dahab, Assa-Zag, Es-Semara, Tata, Taroudant, Zagora, Errachidia, Aousserd, and Boujdour, where temperatures are expected to range between 45°C and 47°C.
The weather authority also forecast temperatures between 42°C and 45°C in the provinces of Marrakech, Beni Mellal, Fquih Ben Salah, and Kelaat Sraghna during the same period.
In addition, hot weather with temperatures ranging from 42°C to 45°C is expected on Sunday and Monday in Agadir-Ida-Ou-Tanane, Rehamna, Youssoufia, Khenifra, Taourirt, Khouribga, Settat, Chichaoua, Guercif, and Taza, as well as the inland areas of the provinces of Laayoune, Tarfaya, Guelmim, and Tan-Tan.
Meanwhile, temperatures between 39°C and 42°C are forecast for Sunday and Monday in Sidi Bennour, Chtouka-Aït Baha, Inezgane-Aït Melloul, Sidi Ifni, Tiznit, Essaouira, Driouch, Nador, Oujda-Angad, and Safi.
The DGM urged residents in the affected areas to remain cautious during the heat wave, particularly during the hottest hours of the day, and to follow official weather updates as temperatures remain significantly above seasonal averages.

title: IMD forecasts scorching heat conditions to continue over parts of Northwest and Central India - News On AIR
full_text:
The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has forecast scorching heat conditions to continue over parts of Northwest and Central India for the next three days and abate thereafter. According to IMD, Haryana, Chandigarh, Delhi, Himachal Pradesh, Jammu and Kashmir, Madhya Pradesh, Punjab, Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Gujarat and Vidarbha will experience heatwave conditions till tomorrow.
The weather agency has predicted Hot and humid weather conditions in isolated pockets over Andhra Pradesh, Kerala, Mahe and Tamil Nadu today. It also said that Haryana, Chandigarh, Delhi, Chhattisgarh and West Madhya Pradesh will likely experience warm night conditions today. The met department has predicted heavy to very heavy rainfall at isolated places over Arunachal Pradesh, Assam and Meghalaya. The weather body predicted Heavy Rainfall at isolated places over Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram, Tripura, West Bengal and Sikkim.
